title: CRC impact definition 1.0
description: Immutable, self-contained impact function: model, calibration, final clamp and provenance. Contains no exposure data, aggregation, output or spatial settings. definition_hash is sha256 of the crc-canonical-json/1 encoding of the normalized definition and is never embedded in it.
